title: Chinese president calls for innovation and new development concepts
description:
Innovation is the base point of China's development as the country should make great efforts to cultivate more innovative enterprises, said Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday during an inspection in Jinan, the provincial seat of east China's Shandong.
